help.title: Help
help.basics.text: Openspacemarin is an idle game where you manage an office full of cat employees. Your cats generate currency every tick. Use that currency to buy more desks and upgrade existing ones.
help.workstations.text: Each workstation holds one cat employee. Cats generate currency automatically every tick. The more desks you have, the more currency you earn. New desks cost more as your office grows.
help.upgrades.text: Upgrading a workstation increases its currency generation. Higher upgrade levels cost more but produce exponentially more currency. Upgrade bars above each desk show the current level: green (0–4), blue (5–9), purple (10–19), gold (20+).
help.achievements.text: Achievements reward milestones with permanent (or temporary) bonus multipliers applied to all currency generation. Check the Achievements screen to see your progress and plan your next goal.
help.controls.text: Desktop: click to select desks, drag to scroll, scroll wheel to zoom. Mobile: tap to select, swipe to scroll, pinch to zoom. Use the speed buttons (1×/2×/4×) to control game pace. Pause stops all generation.
